theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a' ⬝ b', .refl _, .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha''
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb''
      exact ⟨x ⬝ y, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha']
      exact ⟨b', .red_I b', hb'⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha'
      exact ⟨x, .red_K x b', hx⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha'
      exact ⟨x ⬝ b' ⬝ (y ⬝ b'), .red_S x y b', .par (.par hx hb') (.par hy hb')⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl a₁, .red_I a₁⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      exact ⟨a₁', ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨a₁, .refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl a₁, .red_K a₁ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      exact ⟨x, hx, .red_K x c'⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨a₁, .refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      exact ⟨x ⬝ c' ⬝ (y ⬝ c'), .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc), .red_S x y c'⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _⟩
